A man and two boys begin their journey to the sacred mountain, called Cruzco, during the fiestas of Acatlán, Mexico. They will leave the flowers as offerings to Santa Cruz and when they arrive at their destination they will watch or participate in the ritual fight.

Story Summary: In early May the people of this small community leave offerings for Santa Cruz. They also maintain the ancient tradition of fighting in jaguar masks. This is a pre-Columbian tradition in which the blood and sweat that fall to the ground are an offering to earth. In return for their blood the people ask the gods for rain.
